source_set: Archived six-batch term set inside AUTO_LINGO_DATABASE_COMPLETE (1).zip

findings.issue: Manual Transmission is classified as part although its definition describes a complete transmission system/assembly.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy; likely system/assembly rather than part.

findings.issue: Automatic Transmission is classified as part although its definition describes a complete transmission system/assembly.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy; likely system/assembly rather than part.

findings.issue: Pressure Plate is translated as صفحه کلاچ, which is easily confused with Clutch Disc in Persian automotive usage.
findings.recommendation: Use a distinct, workshop-accepted equivalent and distinguish it explicitly from Clutch Disc.

findings.issue: Brake Drum is translated as کاسه چرخ; کاسه ترمز is a clearer component-specific equivalent.
Crankshaft Position Sensor is called سنسور دور موتور, which emphasizes RPM and omits crankshaft position/angle.
findings.recommendation: Use a position-focused Persian name and retain سنسور دور موتور only as a colloquial synonym if appropriate.

findings.issue: Stalling is translated as خاموش کردن موتور (causing the engine to stop), while the definition describes the engine stopping unintentionally.
findings.recommendation: Use خاموش شدن ناخواسته موتور or equivalent.

findings.issue: Tensioner is translated as تسمه‌کش (تایمینگ), but the definition includes belt or chain tensioning and the term is broader.
findings.recommendation: Use a general term and retain timing-belt tensioner as a contextual subtype.

findings.issue: Bearing combines rolling-element bearings and plain/journal bearings under one entry; Persian بلبرینگ / یاتاقان can refer to materially different designs.
findings.recommendation: Split or explicitly scope the concept; do not treat synonyms as fully interchangeable.

findings.issue: Strut is translated as کمک‌فنر ساختاری (مک‌فرسون), while the English definition is broader than MacPherson struts.
findings.recommendation: Use a broader equivalent and keep MacPherson Strut as a subtype/synonym only where justified.

findings.issue: ECU transliteration ایسییو is nonstandard/unclear for Persian readers.
findings.recommendation: Review consistent rendering such as ای‌سی‌یو and maintain abbreviation expansion.

findings.issue: Transmission Fluid is classified as part although it is a fluid/consumable.
findings.recommendation: Review whether schema needs a material/fluid kind or a documented convention.

findings.issue: Brake Fluid is classified as part although it is a fluid/consumable.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy convention for fluids and consumables.

findings.issue: Coolant is classified as part although it is a fluid/consumable.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy convention for fluids and consumables.

findings.issue: Engine Oil is classified as part although it is a fluid/consumable.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy convention for fluids and consumables.

findings.issue: Refrigerant is classified as part although it is a working fluid.
findings.recommendation: Review taxonomy convention for fluids and consumables.

findings.issue: Airbag references Seat Belt Pretensioner, which is absent from the six archived batches.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing concept only in a separately authorized content task, or revise the reference after review.

findings.issue: Body Control Module is categorized under Body & Chassis despite being an electronic control module; the category taxonomy may need a clearer placement rule.
findings.recommendation: Review primary category and cross-category tagging policy.

review_notes: These are editorial/taxonomy triage findings based on the stored definitions and terminology, not externally sourced technical verification.
No original term record was changed.
The archived Batch 01 is used for this triage; the conflicting root-level Batch 01 remains a separate unresolved source.
